description: This file defines API routes for managing a shopping cart in a web application using FastAPI. It includes endpoints for retrieving, adding, updating, removing, and clearing cart items, with JWT authentication, input validation via Pydantic, and comprehensive error handling.

methods.name: CartResponse get_cart(user_id: str = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Retrieve the current user's cart, auto-creating if necessary.

methods.name: CartResponse add_item( item: CartItemRequest = Body( ..., description="Item to add to cart", example={ "product_id": "prod123", "name": "Wireless Keyboard", "price": 59.99, "quantity": 1 } ), user_id: str = Depends(get_current_user) )
methods.description: Add a new item to the cart or update quantity if it exists.

methods.name: CartResponse update_item_quantity( product_id: str, quantity_update: UpdateQuantityRequest = Body( ..., description="New quantity for the item", example={"quantity": 3} ), user_id: str = Depends(get_current_user) )
methods.description: Update the quantity of a specific cart item.

methods.name: CartResponse remove_item( product_id: str, user_id: str = Depends(get_current_user) )
methods.description: Remove a specific item from the cart.

methods.name: CartResponse clear_cart( user_id: str = Depends(get_current_user) )
methods.description: Remove all items from the user's cart, resetting totals.
